messages:
sophie: quick flag — atlas-4b-int4 shows a regression vs fp16 on gold_v9. surprising drop on short QA prompts.

stats: qbench-174555 | sample=2500 | exact_match 0.892 -> 0.847 | accept 0.94 -> 0.90

sophie: did curation change? we rolled a merge last week but I didn't expect this.

diego: which goldset path & dedupe threshold? we adjusted merge dedupe for throughput a couple days ago.

sophie: goldsets/atlas/march/gold_v9.jsonl. run id qbench-174555. suspect dedupe relaxed from 0.95->0.90 during anchor-merge job.

dan: (sorry quick ping) building matrix now.

diego: triage steps: 1) reproduce fp16 on exact tokenized inputs 2) run dedupe at 0.95 and 0.99, compare fail overlap 3) run tok-diff v2->v3 4) if still failing, kernel bisect (kernel-lowp v2->v3) + kv-cache toggle.

sophie: starting step 1+2. uploading commands:
```
python -m curation.dedupe --input gold_v9.jsonl --thresh 0.95 --out gold_v9.dedupe095.jsonl
python -m curation.tokenize --input gold_v9.dedupe095.jsonl --tokenizer v3 --out gold_v9.tok_v3.jsonl
python -m qbench.run --model atlas-4b-fp16 --input gold_v9.tok_v3.jsonl --seed 1234 --out qbench-174555-fp16.jsonl
```

anita: labeling capacity: we can take 180 accelerated today, more tomorrow. annotate diff type: tokenization vs substantive.

label-coordinator: note: include both outputs (fp16 & int4) + context +/-1 turn in the payload to speed labeling. tag: atlas-int4-audit.

build-bot: [qbench-ci] qbench-174555 completed: regression detected. details: https://ci.internal/qbench/174555/overview logs attached.

sophie: exported failures to s3://redwood-curation/exports/qbench-174555-fails-top200.jsonl — includes fp16/int4 outputs, tokdiff count, fail_kind.

diego: nice. run tokdiff script and give percent changed:
```
python -m curation.tokdiff --a gold_v9.tok_v2.jsonl --b gold_v9.tok_v3.jsonl --out tokdiff_174555.json
```

diego: if token-diff <1% and dedupe@0.99 doesn't change regression, escalate kernel bisect. also check kv-cache shortprefix toggle: set KV_SHORTPREFIX=false and rerun 500-sample qbench.

sophie: tokdiff results: ~1.8% prompts have >1 token change; many are URLs and list items. dedupe@0.99 reduced failing set by ~48% overlap — paraphrase collisions definitely explain a chunk.

anita: queued top-180 as label batch LB-5201 tag=atlas-int4-audit, owners=contractors+internal. expected ETA: EOD.

label-coordinator: LB-5201 created. include quick rubric: if fp16 answer correct and int4 wrong -> mark as "regression"; if both wrong or ambiguous -> "gold-noise".

diego: good. I'll start kernel bisect in parallel but prioritize label audit results to decide whether to revert merge vs revert kernel.

sophie: owners: sophie=dataset runs+exports, diego=kernel bisect+tokdiff, anita=label ops, label-coordinator=track batch. will update after labels. :thumbsup:
